text: Driving home for spring break through the Florida countryside, Trish and her brother Darry are run off the road by an old truck, then see its driver [dumping bodies wrapped in bloody sheets down a pipe|trigger|seeing or hearing too much] beside an abandoned church. Darry crawls in and finds a cellar of [corpses sewn to the walls and ceiling|images|corpses and body parts]. A psychic warns them of the song "Jeepers Creepers" and of a creature that [wakes every 23rd spring for 23 days to feed|rules|death on a deadline], choosing its victims by the smell of their fear.
